capabilities: Zoom images with mouse wheel, pinch or toolbar buttons
Pan images by click-and-drag or touch-and-drag
Rotate images with a slider, 45-degree buttons or two-finger gesture
Toggle grayscale mode and reset all transformations
disambiguation: Not a thumbnail or hover-preview generator; it opens clicked images in a modal overlay with transform controls.
problem: Images embedded in Obsidian notes cannot be zoomed, panned or rotated, so inspecting detail means opening an external viewer.
summary: Modal image viewer for Obsidian notes with zoom, pan, rotate, flip, grayscale and reset controls.
